subject: english
title: NOW THE LEAVES ARE FALLING FAST

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When was W.H. Auden born?
questions.explanation: W.H. Auden ka janam saal 1907 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When did W.H. Auden die?
questions.explanation: W.H. Auden ka nidhan saal 1973 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which prize did W.H. Auden win in 1948?
questions.explanation: W.H. Auden ko saal 1948 mein unki kriti 'The Age of Anxiety' ke liye Pulitzer Prize mila tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: For which collection did W.H. Auden win the Pulitzer Prize?
questions.explanation: Auden ne 'The Age of Anxiety' ke liye 1948 mein Pulitzer Prize jeeta tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which type of poet is W.H. Auden described as?
questions.explanation: Auden ko ek intellectually vigorous kavi aur aalochak ke roop mein jaana jaata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: To W.H. Auden, poetry was a ..........
questions.explanation: Auden ke anusaar kavita ek gambhir khel yani 'serious game' thi jo aatm-chetna ko gehra karti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: He had a passion for word-coining and using .......... words.
questions.explanation: Auden ko naye shabd gadhne aur pracheen yaani archaic shabdon ka prayog karne ka shauk tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: He left England as early as .......... to settle permanently in the United States.
questions.explanation: Auden ne saal 1939 mein England chhodkar America mein sthayi roop se basne ka faisla kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: His notable works are divided into .......... phases.
questions.explanation: Unke sahityik jeevan ko do charnon (British phase aur American phase) mein baanta gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'The Age of Anxiety' belongs to Auden's .......... phase.
questions.explanation: 'The Age of Anxiety' unke American daur ki rachna hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast' is written by ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh prasiddh kavita W. H. Auden dwara likhi gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast' enacts the .......... inherent in human life.
questions.explanation: Yeh kavita manav jeevan mein nihit nirasha yani frustration aur akelepan ko vyakt karti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Frustration in human life arises because our .......... are not fulfilled.
questions.explanation: Jeevan mein nirasha tab aati hai jab hamari aakankshayein (aspirations) adhuri reh jaati hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'And the prams go .......... on.'
questions.explanation: Kavita ki mool pankti hai: 'And the prams go rolling on'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... neighbours, left and right, pluck us from the real delight.
questions.explanation: Kavita mein 'Whispering neighbours, left and right' ka varnan hai jo yamdoot ka prateek hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who run scolding for their food through the leafless wood?
questions.explanation: 'Trolls run scolding for their food' ke anusaar trolls bhookh se vyakul hokar daudte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Whose .......... waterfall could bless travellers in their last distress?
questions.explanation: Kavita ki aakhiri panktiyon mein parvat ke safed jharne ('White waterfall') ka zikr hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The .......... has become dumb to see the leafless trees.
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'And the nightingale is dumb', arthath gaane wali chidiya maun ho chuki hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Nurse's flowers will not last, nurses to the .......... are gone.
questions.explanation: Kavita ki pankti hai: 'Nurses to the grave are gone'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The falling of leaves refers to the speedy arrival of ..........
questions.explanation: Patton ka tezi se girna manushya ke jeevan ke aakhiri padaav aur mrityu ka sanket hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The 'travellers' in the poem are .......... moving towards their death.
questions.explanation: Yatri ke roop mein manushya (human beings) hain jo jeevan-yatra poori kar mrityu ki or ja rahe hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Trees shed their leaves primarily in the season of ..........
questions.explanation: Ped patjhad yaani Autumn ritu mein apne patte gira dete hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the line 'Follow wooden in our track', 'wooden' refers to ..........
questions.explanation: 'Wooden' ka sanket lakdi ke taboot (coffins) ki or hai jisme shav rakhe jaate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'And the angle (angel) will not come' means there will be no ..........
questions.explanation: Iska taatparya hai ki aakhiri samay mein manushya ko bachane koi daivi sahayata nahi aati.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Whose white waterfall could bless travellers in their last ..........?
questions.explanation: Kavita ki aakhiri pankti hai: 'Travellers in their last distress'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Continuity amidst .......... is the eternal truth depicted through rolling prams.
questions.explanation: Nashwarta (mortality) ke bavjood jeevan-chakra ka nirantar chalna is kavita ka mool sandesh hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Troll is an ugly, wicked creature belonging to .......... mythology.
questions.explanation: Trolls Scandinavian (Norse) mythology ke bhayanak aur aam taur par dushit jeev maane jaate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When death approaches, the active hands must ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita ke anusaar: 'And the active hands must freeze Lonely on the separate knees'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet's attitude to life in this poem is not entirely ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita nirasha se shuru hoti hai kintu ant mein jharna aasha aur mukti darshata hai, atah yeh poori tarah pessimistic nahi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The lyric 'Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast' is composed in .......... stanzas.
questions.explanation: Yeh kavita char-char panktiyon ke padon (quatrains) mein rachit hai jinki rhyme scheme AABB hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the full name of W. H. Auden?
questions.explanation: W. H. Auden ka poora naam Wystan Hugh Auden hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following books belongs to Auden's British phase?
questions.explanation: 'The Dance of Death' Auden ke British daur ki rachna hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following works was composed during Auden's American phase?
questions.explanation: 'The Shield of Achilles' unke American daur ka prasiddh sangrah hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the poem, what do 'whispering neighbours' primarily symbolize?
questions.explanation: 'Whispering neighbours' vastav mein mrityu ke duto (messengers of death) ka roopak hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'Prams'?
questions.explanation: 'Prams' bachhon ko ghumane wali char pahiye ki gaadi (perambulator) ko kehte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does 'Nurse's flowers will not last' symbolically indicate?

options.A: Flowers fade quickly in the hot sun
options.B: Mortal life, beauty, and earthly protections are transient

questions.explanation: Iska symbolic arth yeh hai ki manushya ka jeevan aur saansarik aashray kshanbhangur hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the line 'Dead in hundreds at the back', what does the poet refer to?

options.A: Generations of people who have already died

questions.explanation: Peechhe mare pade sainkdon log un pichhli peedhiyon ko darshate hain jo mrityu ko prapt ho chuki hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does 'leafless wood' symbolize in this lyric?

options.B: A devastated, barren and helpless society

questions.explanation: 'Leafless wood' manav jeevan ke sukhepan, akelepan aur sansadhanheen sthiti ko darshata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the rhyme scheme of each stanza in 'Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast'?
questions.explanation: Kavita ke har stanza mein AABB rhyme scheme chalti hai (jaise fast/last, gone/on).

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the line 'Arms raised stiffly to reprove', what does 'reprove' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Reprove' ka arth daantna, phatkaar lagana ya ninda karna hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the mountain's white waterfall symbolize in the final stanza?

options.B: Peace, consolation, and final release from life's agonies

questions.explanation: Safed jharna aakhiri kashton se mukti, shanti aur aatmik santosh ka prateek hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does 'Pluck us from the real delight' mean in context?

options.B: Deprive humans of true joy and vitality of life
options.C: Take people to an amusement park

questions.explanation: Iska arth hai manushya ko uske aam jeevan ke sachhe anand aur sukhoon se chheen lena.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Auden's later poems were overtly influenced by ..........
questions.explanation: Auden ki baad ki rachnayein spasht roop se Christian aadhyaatm aur vichaaron se prabhavit theen.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the synonym of the word 'Freeze' used in the poem?
questions.explanation: 'Freeze' ka arth thanda hokar sunn ya kathor (rigid/stiff) ho jaana hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What literary role did W.H. Auden NOT perform?
questions.explanation: Auden kavi, natakkar, aalochak aur anuwadak the, parantu commercial pilot nahi the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The phrase 'false attitudes of love' satirizes ..........

options.B: hypocritical and artificial social gestures of sympathy

questions.explanation: Yeh samaj ke dikhawati prem aur jhuthe aadar-samman ke dhong par vyangya karta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does 'scolding for their food' indicate about the trolls?

options.B: Their desperation, greed, and aggressive hunger in difficult times

questions.explanation: Yeh dikhata hai ki kathin paristithi mein log bhookh aur lalach ke kaaran kitne aakramak ho jaate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The dumbness of the nightingale represents the death of ..........

options.B: beauty, joy, music, and artistic expression

questions.explanation: Bulbul ka maun hona sundarta, sangeet aur ullas ke samapt hone ka prateek hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In 'Cold, impossible, ahead / Lifts the mountain's lovely head', what does 'cold' mean?

options.B: Distant, challenging, and unfeeling yet majestic

questions.explanation: Yeh parvat ki kathin, duruh aur shaant unchayi ko darshata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which political event significantly impacted Auden's early works?

options.A: The Spanish Civil War and political crises of 1930s Europe

questions.explanation: 1930 ke dashak ke rajneetik sankat aur Spanish Civil War ne unki shuruaati kavitaon ko prabhavit kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Active' as used in 'active hands must freeze'?
questions.explanation: 'Active' (sakriya) ka vipritarthak shabd 'Passive' ya 'Idle' (nishkriya) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What grammatical class does the word 'stiffly' belong to in 'Arms raised stiffly'?
questions.explanation: 'Stiffly' ek Adverb hai jo 'raised' verb ki visheshta batata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poet mean by 'separate knees' in 'Lonely on the separate knees'?

options.A: Sitting alone in isolation and helplessness

questions.explanation: Yeh sharir ke alag-thalag pad jaane aur akelepan mein baithne ki lachar sthiti ko darshata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poem 'Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast' contains how many stanzas in total?
questions.explanation: Yeh kavita kul 5 padon (stanzas) mein likhi gayi hai, jisme pratyek mein 4 panktiyan hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The total number of lines in 'Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast' is ..........
questions.explanation: 5 stanzas × 4 lines = kul 20 panktiyan (lines) hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of 'distress' in 'travellers in their last distress'?

options.A: Extreme pain, sorrow, or dying agony

questions.explanation: 'Distress' ka arth ghor peeda, kasht ya antim samay ki vedna hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which century did W.H. Auden primarily belong to?
questions.explanation: Auden ka jivan-kaal 1907 se 1973 tak tha, isliye we 20th century ke mukhya kavi hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to Auden, poetry should deepen people's ..........
questions.explanation: Auden ke anusar kavita ka uddeshya logon ki aatm-chetna (self-awareness) ko gehra karna hona chahiye.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the primary allegory underlying the poem 'Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast'?

options.B: The journey of human life from active youth to old age and eventual death
options.C: A scientific analysis of autumn leaves
options.D: A political speech about child nurseries

questions.explanation: Kavita patton ke jhadne ke madhyam se manav jeevan ke yuvaavastha se budhape aur antatah mrityu tak ki yatra ka roopak prastut karti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which work among the following is a verse play by W. H. Auden and Christopher Isherwood?
questions.explanation: 'The Ascent of F6' Auden dwara apne sahyogi Christopher Isherwood ke sath likha gaya prasiddh kavya-natak (verse drama) hai.
